body:
Choosing a dentist comes down to trust, clear explanations and results. At Valencia Dentistry in Santa Clarita, your first visit is designed to give you an accurate diagnosis, realistic options and a comfort plan that fits you. You see Dr. Nuriel Lavi himself, not a rotating team. This guide walks through what happens, what to bring, the most common outcomes, and how we handle insurance, payment and sedation.

## Why patients choose us

- **One dentist, every visit.** Dr. Lavi performs your exam and explains the reasoning behind each recommendation. No handoffs, no rush.
- **Modern diagnostics.** Digital X-rays, intraoral cameras, 3D CBCT imaging when needed, and periodontal screening to catch problems early and treat them conservatively.
- **Clear, phased treatment plans.** Options, timelines and written estimates so you can prioritize.
- **Comfort first.** Plain-language chairside communication and sedation options for anxious patients.
- **Holistic, biocompatible care.** Materials chosen with your whole-body health in mind, and a focus on prevention.
- **Continuity and safety.** Secure records, clear follow-up and evidence-based infection control.

## Before your visit

- **Bring ID and your insurance card.** We can pre-verify benefits if you ask when booking. Most major PPO plans are accepted.
- **List medications and medical history.** Prescriptions, allergies, heart conditions, diabetes, pregnancy or recent surgery.
- **Complete intake forms online.** It keeps clinical time focused on you.
- **Write down your priorities.** Sensitivity, a missing tooth, whitening, anything on your mind.
- **Allow 60 to 90 minutes.** A comprehensive exam with imaging and a cleaning usually needs that long.

New patients can take advantage of our $59 exam and X-rays special.

## Check-in

At check-in we confirm your contact and insurance details, review your medical history and answer billing questions. If you arrive early, you can finish any outstanding forms.

## The exam, step by step

1. **Medical and dental history review** to identify risks or medication interactions.
2. **Visual exam** of teeth, gums, tongue, soft tissues and bite.
3. **Digital X-rays as needed**: bitewings, periapicals or a panoramic image to check for decay, bone level and root health.
4. **Intraoral photos** so you can see what we see. They stay in your chart for future comparison.
5. **Periodontal screening**, measuring pocket depths and bleeding to identify gum disease.
6. **TMJ and bite check** for clenching, wear or alignment issues.
7. **Oral cancer screening**, a visual and tactile check of the soft tissues.

Findings are explained in plain language as we go, with time for your questions.

## The cleaning

- **Assessment** of gum health to set the right depth of cleaning.
- **Scaling** with ultrasonic and hand instruments to remove tartar and reduce inflammation.
- **Polishing** to remove surface stain and smooth the teeth.
- **Fluoride or desensitizing treatment** when indicated.
- **Home-care coaching** tailored to you.

## Your treatment plan

After the exam, we review findings together and lay out options, from conservative to restorative to cosmetic. Urgent needs come first. You receive written estimates and images so you can decide on timing and budget. If a specialist is needed, we coordinate the referral and transfer your records.

## Comfort and sedation options

- **Topical and local anesthesia** for routine procedures.
- **Nitrous oxide** for mild to moderate anxiety while you stay responsive.
- **Oral conscious sedation** for deeper relaxation; you will need someone to drive you.
- **IV sedation or general anesthesia** for complex surgery or severe anxiety, coordinated with qualified anesthesiologists.

## Insurance, payment and financing

We verify benefits and give you an itemized estimate up front. We accept major credit and debit cards and cash, offer third-party financing subject to approval, and file insurance claims on your behalf.

## Common first-visit outcomes

- **Routine preventive care.** Cleaning, then a recheck in 3 to 6 months.
- **Minor restorative work.** Fillings usually scheduled within a few weeks.
- **Phased restorative care.** Crowns, bridges or implants planned over weeks or months, with specialist coordination if needed.
- **Emergencies.** Acute pain or infection handled the same day or with priority scheduling.

## Infection control

We follow evidence-based sterilization protocols, use single-use disposables where appropriate, clean operatories between patients, and follow recommended protective equipment and hand hygiene procedures.

## Follow-up and aftercare

- Clear post-operative instructions covering pain control, diet and activity.
- Signs to watch for, such as fever or excessive bleeding, and how to reach us.
- Scheduling for suture removal, restorative steps or specialist visits.

## Practical tips

- Bring a companion if you plan on sedation or expect to discuss financing.
- Follow any fasting instructions we give you before sedation.
- Keep the photos and written estimates for comparison later.

## Ready to book

Call (661) 254-5200 or [book online](/contact/). We are at 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, Santa Clarita, CA 91355, open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. Bring your ID, insurance information and a short list of concerns. If you like, we can pre-verify insurance and prepare a sample estimate before you arrive.

*A note on outcomes:* we provide evidence-based care and honest treatment planning. Results vary by individual and are never guaranteed. This guide is general information, not a substitute for personalized medical advice.

faq.q: How long will my first visit take?
faq.a: Plan for 60 to 90 minutes for a comprehensive exam, imaging and a cleaning when needed. If you need a quick emergency visit instead, call us and we will reserve a same-day slot.

faq.q: Will I need X-rays at the first visit?
faq.a: Digital X-rays are taken selectively to diagnose issues that are not visible during the exam. We take the minimum needed and explain why each image is recommended. Digital imaging uses less radiation than older film techniques.
We accept most major PPO plans and can verify benefits before your visit. Bring your insurance card and ID, or ask for pre-verification when booking to get a coverage estimate.

faq.q: What sedation options do you offer for anxious patients?
faq.a: We offer topical and local anesthesia, nitrous oxide and oral conscious sedation. For complex surgical cases or severe anxiety, we coordinate IV sedation or general anesthesia with qualified anesthesiologists when appropriate.

faq.q: Can I get a second opinion?
faq.a: Yes, and we encourage it. We provide complete records, images and a written summary you can take to another provider or specialist.

faq.q: What should I bring to my appointment?
faq.a: Bring ID, your insurance card if you are using insurance, a list of medications and allergies, and any recent dental records. Writing down your top two or three concerns beforehand helps make sure nothing is missed.
